_: Shared fixture: the host (src/) and the container agent-runner are separate package trees and cannot import each other, so the rules they both implement are asserted against this one file from both sides. Keep it dependency-free JSON.

limits._: How a catalog's raw (context, output) pair becomes recorded limits. An output cap at or above the whole context window is the absence of a cap — 47 of the Vercel gateway's 226 models and 1309 of models.dev's 6652 report it that way, and storing it renders a budget bar that can never move.

cases.why: a real cap below the window
cap equal to the window is no cap
cap above the window is no cap

wire._: container_configs.model under the opencode provider is always stored fully qualified as <upstream>/<model-id>, with upstream_provider naming that same upstream. The host joins (src/model-wire.ts), the container peels the prefix back off (providers/opencode.ts).

cases.why: plain id under a direct upstream
id that itself contains a slash
id starting with its own upstream's name
